Delhi Approves ₹10 Lakh Annual Health Cover for Transgender Community

The Delhi government has approved an annual health cover of ₹10 lakh for transgender persons. This inclusion will be under the Ayushman Bharat scheme. The decision was made by the Delhi Cabinet.
